requirements.requirement: The system must include a new_patient_acceptance field in the provider evaluation response returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must include a new_patient_acceptance field in the provider detail response returned by provider_detail_service.
The system must ensure the new_patient_acceptance value is one of the allowed enum values: yes, no, or unknown.
The system must propagate the normalized new_patient_acceptance value from backend logic (EVAL-P7-S2) without transformation or mutation.
The system must include source attribution for new_patient_acceptance in the evaluation response if available.
The system must include last_verified timestamp for new_patient_acceptance in the evaluation response if available.
The system must return new_patient_acceptance as unknown when no acceptance data is available for a provider.
The system must not omit the new_patient_acceptance field from the response even when the value is unknown.
The system must ensure backward compatibility by not removing or altering existing fields in evaluate_care_facade or provider_detail_service responses.
The system must return a valid response with new_patient_acceptance set to unknown if the upstream normalization logic fails or returns null.
The system must handle conflicting upstream acceptance signals by returning the resolved normalized value provided by the inference logic.
The system must ensure that inclusion of new_patient_acceptance does not increase response latency beyond acceptable service thresholds defined for evaluate_care_facade.
